originalEntry.title: Distilbook explainer with an Oppenheimer-style score

originalEntry.author: ajith_io
originalEntry.description: A 40-second motion graphics promo explaining Distilbook, scored with original music Opus composed in the spirit of the Oppenheimer theme.
originalEntry.description_zh: 介绍 Distilbook 的 40 秒动态图形宣传片，配乐由 Opus 以《奥本海默》主题曲为灵感自己创作。
originalEntry.prompt: Make a dynamic 40-second motion graphics video on Distilbook that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel - go all out. Use the Oppenheimer theme music as inspiration, but compose it yourself.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 制作一段关于 Distilbook 的 40 秒动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师，就像你的作品集一样——拿出全部本事。以《奥本海默》的主题音乐为灵感，但要自己作曲。
